name: Foot Pincer

stealth.note: (trained); DC 20 Perception check when the bat swarm is active

description: A metal pincer trap lies hidden at the bottom of a weakened spot in the floor.
disable: DC 17 Thievery check to jam the pincer's triggeer mechanism.
reset: The foot pincer must be reset manually before it can activate again.

offensiveAbilities.name: Slam Shut
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature steps onto a foot pincer

Effect The trap slams shut on the triggering creature's foot. The creature must succeed at a DC 18 Reflex save or take 1d6+5 slashing damage and 1d4 bleed.
